name: File input (choose files to upload)
plain: Opens the system file chooser; the page gets only the files the person picks.
meaning: The most common way a site reaches a person's files. The person picks exactly what is shared, and the site sees name, size, type and modified time, but not the folder path.

web.api: <input type=file multiple accept=...>; input.files; File, FileList

access.prompt_ui: System file chooser dialog (the person picks files)
access.persistence: Per selection; File objects live until the page unloads
access.revocation: Nothing to revoke (no permission is stored)
access.iframe: Works in any frame; no permission policy
steps: Person clicks the input or a label
Page receives FileList with File objects

limits.headline: Can open only the files you pick in the file chooser
limits.user_action: You tap Choose file, Upload or Attach, then pick.
can: Open the files you choose, one or several
See their name, size and type
cannot: See other files or folders on your device
Keep access after you close or reload the page

story.what_it_is: Opens your system's file chooser, and the page gets only the files you pick.

marketing.name: input type file
marketing.pitch: Documents the standard way a page asks a person to choose files to share.

story.for_you: You tap 'Choose file', pick a photo or document in a system window, and the page gets only that one. It cannot see anything else on your device.
story.for_makers: It is the safest, oldest way to get files. It works everywhere with no permission pop up, which is why upload forms are built on it.

use_cases.example: You pick a profile photo from your camera roll.
You choose a PDF statement to upload to a loan application.
You choose an essay file to submit to a class.
You choose a file to attach to a message.
You pick a scan or lab result to share with a clinic.
You pick a profile avatar or a custom skin for a browser game.
You pick a photo to send for a return request.

technical_bounds: Can open the picker only from a click, tap or key press (input.showPicker also needs activation)
The path is hidden: value shows C:\fakepath\name; no folder, no sibling files
Cannot set files programmatically to a chosen path; only via DataTransfer from existing File objects
Reads the file as it is at read time; later edits throw NotReadableError in Chrome and Safari if the file changed
accept filter is a hint, not enforcement; no size limit from the browser (memory bound)

abuse: Tricking people into uploading private files
Reading photo metadata (GPS EXIF) from uploads

history.change: HTMLInputElement.showPicker() ships, so a script can open the chooser from its own gesture handler
